Class EiaRoutingProtocolRequest

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model.json.creators.EiaRoutingProtocolRequest
public class EiaRoutingProtocolRequest extends Object
Routing protocol configuration for an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) service create request.

Faithful to the spec's InternetAccessRoutingProtocolRequest (and its BGP variant): a type discriminator, a list of customer routes referencing IP block UUIDs, a list of connection UUIDs, plus the BGP-only fields (exportPolicy, customerAsn, bgpAuthKey, customerAsnRange) which are simply omitted (NON_NULL) for the DIRECT and STATIC variants.
